description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for managing hosts and network devices in a LAN management system, including host information, IP address management, and presence detection.

classes.name: LmObjectHost
classes.description: Represents a network host with properties such as IP addresses, activity status, and device type.

classes.name: LmObjectHostIPAddress
classes.description: Represents an IP address associated with a host, including active status and lease time.

classes.name: LmObjectHosts
classes.description: Container for multiple host objects, managing their collection and presence detection parameters.

methods.name: Host_AddIPAddress
methods.description: Adds an IP address to a host object, specifying IP version.

methods.name: Hosts_PollHost
methods.description: Performs polling of host statuses.

methods.name: LM_main
methods.description: Main entry point for LAN management operations.

methods.name: LM_get_online_device
methods.description: Retrieves the count of online devices.

methods.name: LMDmlHostsSetHostComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for a host identified by MAC address.

methods.name: FindParentIPInExtenderList
methods.description: Finds parent IP in extender list based on MAC address.

methods.name: FindMACByIPAddress
methods.description: Finds MAC address associated with an IP address.

methods.name: Wifi_Server_Sync_Function
methods.description: Synchronizes WiFi server data.

methods.name: convert_ssid_to_radio
methods.description: Converts SSID to radio interface.

methods.name: LM_FindIPv4BaseFromLink
methods.description: Finds IPv4 base address from link.

methods.name: Hosts_GetPresenceNotificationEnableStatus
methods.description: Checks if presence notification is enabled for a MAC address.

methods.name: Hosts_CheckAndUpdatePresenceDeviceMac
methods.description: Checks and updates presence device MAC address.

methods.name: Hosts_UpdateSysDb
methods.description: Updates system database with parameter value.

methods.name: Update_RFC_Presencedetection
methods.description: Enables or disables presence detection feature.

methods.name: Hosts_PresenceHandling
methods.description: Handles presence status for a host.

methods.name: Hosts_UpdateDeviceIntoPresenceDetection
methods.description: Updates device presence detection status.

methods.name: LM_GetIPArr_FromIndex
methods.description: Retrieves IP address array from host by index.

methods.name: addHostsToPresenceTable
methods.description: Adds hosts to presence detection table.

methods.name: acquirePresencelocks
methods.description: Acquires locks for presence detection.

methods.name: releasePresenceLocks
methods.description: Releases presence detection locks.

methods.name: Hosts_FindHostByPhysAddress
methods.description: Finds host object by physical (MAC) address.

methods.name: Hosts_AddHostByPhysAddress
methods.description: Adds a new host by physical address.

methods.name: Hosts_GetPresenceParamFromSysDb
methods.description: Retrieves presence detection parameters from system database.

methods.name: Hosts_stop_scan
methods.description: Stops host scanning process.

methods.name: Hosts_EnablePresenceDetectionTask
methods.description: Enables presence detection task.

methods.name: Hosts_DisablePresenceDetectionTask
methods.description: Disables presence detection task.

methods.name: EthClient_AddtoQueue
methods.description: Adds Ethernet client info to queue.

methods.name: MoCA_Server_Sync_Function
methods.description: Synchronizes MoCA network device info.

methods.name: XHosts_SyncWifi
methods.description: Synchronizes WiFi hosts (conditional compilation).

methods.name: XLM_get_online_device
methods.description: Gets online device info (conditional compilation).

methods.name: XLM_get_host_info
methods.description: Gets host info (conditional compilation).

methods.name: XLM_get_online_device
methods.description: Gets online device info (conditional compilation).

methods.name: readPresenceFromSyscfg
methods.description: Reads presence detection setting from system configuration.
